title: Unbounded HTTP controls
evidence_summary: Requests previously lacked centralized body and abuse controls
exploit_scenario: Repeated large or expensive requests could consume memory/CPU
remediation: Added bounded body middleware and endpoint buckets

title: Permissive CORS policy
evidence_summary: Wildcard methods/headers and credentials were enabled
exploit_scenario: Unapproved browser origin could make credentialed requests
remediation: Normalized configurable origins and minimized methods/headers; credentials disabled
residual_risk: Deployment must configure exact frontend origin

title: Missing request correlation and response headers
evidence_summary: No request ID or standard security headers were present
exploit_scenario: Operators could not correlate abuse and browser protections were weaker
remediation: Added validated UUID request IDs and security headers/CSP

title: Raw parser exception/log content
evidence_summary: Exception strings and input-derived values could reach logs/responses
exploit_scenario: Malformed email could expose implementation or sensitive content
remediation: Replaced with safe reason codes/messages and redacted logging

title: Model paths not contained
evidence_summary: Configured paths were resolved without approved-root containment
exploit_scenario: Path traversal or external override could select an unintended artifact
remediation: Contain resolved registry and override paths under services/ml and verify hashes before load

title: Inline theme script weakened CSP
exploit_scenario: Future changes could turn inline script into an injection sink
remediation: Removed inline script and added restrictive production headers
residual_risk: style-src still permits inline styles for framework compatibility

title: Process-local rate limiter
exploit_scenario: Multi-instance attacker can distribute requests across workers
remediation: Documented accepted limitation and made limits configurable
residual_risk: Use shared gateway/store before multi-instance production

title: No API authentication/authorization
evidence_summary: All analysis routes are public and Firebase is optional
exploit_scenario: Anyone with the endpoint can submit synthetic or sensitive email
remediation: Explicitly documented as a release boundary; authentication not added per scope
